label: Tennis

criteria.label: Arm extension at contact
criteria.look_for: arm extended out in front at contact
criteria.drill: Hit at a target with a full extension, freeze at contact.

criteria.label: Balance
criteria.look_for: balanced body, no falling away from the shot
criteria.drill: Shadow swings and hold the finish for two seconds.

criteria.label: Leg drive
criteria.look_for: knees loaded and driving into the ball
criteria.drill: Split-step then load: ten forehands with a deliberate knee bend.

criteria.label: Contact height
criteria.look_for: contact at a comfortable height, arm not cramped

camera_angles.label: Side view
camera_angles.description: Camera at 90 degrees to the action. Best for arm extension and lean.

camera_angles.label: Front view
camera_angles.description: Camera facing the athlete. Best for balance and knee alignment.

coaching_note: Judge the stroke: preparation, contact point, balance, finish.
